decisions.quote: We found knockdown of CRAF, but not BRAF, in mutant RAS cells attenuated the phospho-MEK induction observed after PLX4720 treatment, similar to the original study (Figure 2B; Hatzivassiliou et al., 2010). The original study reported analogous results with GDC-0879, which was not observed in this replication, although unexpected control results confound the interpretation.
decisions.reason: The replication re-tested multiple experiments from Hatzivassiliou et al. (2010) and reported results matching the original study for cell proliferation (Figure 1A) and PLX4720 treatment (Figure 2B), but failing to replicate the analogous GDC-0879 result, making the overall outcome mixed rather than failed.
